summary: This is a plain-vanilla Form 8-K filed by BMO 2026-5C15 Mortgage Trust to report the issuance and sale of commercial mortgage pass-through certificates under a pooling and servicing agreement. The filing discloses the closing date, parties (depositor, master servicer, special servicer, underwriters), and classes of certificates, with public certificates totaling $553,359,000 sold to underwriters. There are no merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, spin-off, rights offering, or capital return elements. It is a routine securitization closing report.
